item.title: [War on the Rocks] Winning Time: Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces and the New Dimension of War
item.description: In late 2023, Ukraine’s military leadership faced an institutional choice: establish a dedicated branch of the armed forces for unmanned systems or integrate drones into existing branches.
